title: The Euler characteristic of a coherent module equals the alternating sum of the Euler characteristics of its higher direct images
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file varieties.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves chi(Y, G) = sum (-1)^i chi(X, R^i f_* G) for a morphism f : Y -> X of proper schemes over a field and a coherent G on Y. The proof first checks that the formula makes sense, using coherence and finiteness of the higher direct images, then applies the Leray spectral sequence with E_2^{p,q} = H^p(X, R^q f_* G) converging to H^{p+q}(Y, G) (proof lines 6286-6295). Finiteness of cohomology on X makes all E_2 terms finite dimensional and almost all zero, so the alternating sum of dimensions is independent of the page; since E_r stabilizes and convergence means a filtration on H^n(Y, G) with graded pieces E_infty^{p,q}, the alternating sums agree and the formula follows (proof lines 6296-6309). H2: the spectral-sequence bookkeeping through the alternating sum of dimensions is the substance and is a genuinely non-trivial assembly of cited machinery.
